question: How do their results compare to state-of-the-art?
title: Offensive Language Detection: A Comparative Analysis
answer_rationale: The highest F1-score of 82.9% achieved by team BIBREF3 in Sub-task A serves as the state-of-the-art benchmark, as it is the top performance among the 104 participating teams. This is explicitly stated in Text 4 and supported by Text 1, which references Table TABREF19 showing the top 5 teams' performance, with the first-ranked team achieving this score.
